iadlAssessment.title: Instrumental Activities of Daily Living Scale (IADL)

telephoneOptions: Operates telephone on own initiative — looks up and dials numbers, etc.
Answers telephone but does not dial
Does not use telephone at all
shoppingOptions: Takes care of all shopping needs independently
Needs to be accompanied on any shopping trip
foodPrepOptions: Plans, prepares and serves adequate meals independently
Prepares adequate meals if supplied with ingredients
Heats, serves and prepares meals, or prepares meals but does not maintain adequate diet
Needs to have meals prepared and served
selectedFoodPrepOption: Prepares adequate meals if supplied with ingredients
housekeepingOptions: Maintains house alone or with occasional assistance (e.g. "heavy work domestic help")
Performs light daily tasks such as dish washing, bed making
Performs light daily tasks but cannot maintain acceptable level of cleanliness
Needs help with all home maintenance tasks
Does not participate in any housekeeping tasks
selectedHousekeepingOption: Performs light daily tasks such as dish washing, bed making
laundryOptions: Launders small items — rinses stockings, etc.
All laundry must be done by others
selectedLaundryOption: Launders small items — rinses stockings, etc.
transportationOptions: Travels independently on public transportation or drives own car
Arranges own travel via taxi, but does not otherwise use public transportation
Travels on public transportation when assisted by another
Travel limited to taxi or automobile with assistance of another
selectedTransportationOption: Travels on public transportation when assisted by another
medicationsOptions: Is responsible for taking medication in correct dosages at correct time
Takes responsibility if medication is prepared in advance in separate dosages
Is not capable of dispensing own medication
selectedMedicationsOption: Takes responsibility if medication is prepared in advance in separate dosages
updatedMedicationsOption: Is responsible for taking medication in correct dosages at correct time
financesOptions: Manages financial matters independently (budgets, writes checks, pays rent/bills, goes to bank); collects and keeps track of income
Manages day-to-day purchases but needs help with banking, major purchases, etc.
selectedFinancesOption: Manages day-to-day purchases but needs help with banking, major purchases, etc.
